claims.claim: KV cache sharing shards persistent pages among prefill ranks, with shared logical radix tree and request-to-token mapping.
Owner and local row are arithmetic functions of logical slot, shard size and page size.
Per-layer all-gather restores logical order in alternating temporary buffers; HiCache preserves ownership and PD sends owned pages.
